events.text_en: A war-orphan ship's boy from burned Vô Định Thành comes to Tương Phùng Thị with a ledger he will not put down; Bình Thủy's ferrymen take him in and name him for the duckweed.
The last disciple of Phiêu Bồng Quán goes down the cliff path with a ferryman and does not come back; her master spends the winter alone.
Bùi Phiêu Bình fights the Claw King of Cự Ngao Chử through two tides and kills it at slack water.
Bình Thủy Môn raises its Tide Hall on stilts over the shoal; the old hall above the landing becomes the Strangers' Hall.
The first deep-water boat Lận Viễn Phàm pays for sails west past the Cô Phàm charts with a Bình Thủy crew and is not seen again.
The second boat, under the captain Tôn Viễn Hàng, follows the first. Lận Viễn Phàm takes his own disciple off it at the quay.
A child is found asleep against the stranded whale of Tình Sa; Bình Thủy's head takes her home.
